answer: Each participant must post a slashable bond binding identity to stake. Two hundred sock-puppet accounts means locking two hundred stakes, each forfeit the moment collusion is proven, so swarm cost scales linearly while payouts stay capped. Fresh accounts also start at zero reputation and must spiral upward through slow verified work, burning real compute. One honest peer then out-earns the whole farm, and the river of effort draining the attacker's pocket outweighs any reward, like a dull umber stain on a losing ledger.
